## ElevenLabs Scribe V2 API

ElevenLabs Scribe V2 is a speech-to-text model by ElevenLabs, available on the Venice API as `elevenlabs/scribe-v2`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

### ElevenLabs Scribe V2 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elevenlabs/scribe-v2` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.6012 / audio hr |

### ElevenLabs Scribe V2 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | ElevenLabs |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |

### How to use the ElevenLabs Scribe V2 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions` with `"model": "elevenlabs/scribe-v2"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -F model=elevenlabs/scribe-v2 \
  -F file=@meeting.mp3
```
